definition: Ion Stoica (born 1964 or 1965) is a Romanian–American computer scientist specializing in distributed systems, cloud computing and computer networking.
details: Co-founded Databricks and Anyscale, and directs UC Berkeley's Sky Computing Lab behind Ray, vLLM, and LMSYS. He is a professor of computer science at the University of California, Berkeley and co-director of AMPLab. He co-founded Conviva and Databricks with other original developers of Apache Spark and Anyscale with other original developers of Ray.
